title: Store.Exec still hands out the raw transaction after the #118 fix
problem: The `Store.Exec` added by the fix for #118 returns the underlying `*sql.Tx`, so handlers still build SQL against the driver.

title: Index row types leak out of the store package
problem: `IndexRow` is an exported driver scan type that handlers import directly, so a column change forces edits in every handler.
fix: Unexport it and return a domain type.

title: Reconciler reaches into index internals
problem: `Reconcile` reads `index.rows` directly instead of going through the store API, so reordering the index breaks it.
fix: Add an accessor on the store.
